parts.gloss: not happening or not suffering (negative relative participle)

literal: To the two who love, sweet indeed is the embrace that does not allow the wind to pass in between.
translation: Sweet indeed to two lovers is an embrace so close that even the wind cannot pass between them.
modern: ஒருவரையொருவர் விரும்பும் இருவருக்கு, இடையில் காற்று கூடப் புக முடியாதபடி நெருக்கமாக இருக்கும் தழுவல் மிகவும் இனிமையானது.
explanation: This couplet beautifully captures the physical and emotional closeness of lovers. The phrase 'வீழும் இருவர்' refers to two people who are deeply in love with each other. Their embrace ('முயக்கு') is described as being so tight and seamless that even the wind ('வளி') cannot find a gap to pass through ('போழப் படாஅ') or separate them. This vivid imagery emphasizes that true union leaves absolutely no room for distance or separation, making it the sweetest experience ('இனிதே') for the lovers.
